instructions: This is a Next.js 16 portfolio website using App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4.
Use the `src/` directory structure with `@/*` import alias.
Follow React Server Components by default; add 'use client' only when needed.
Use Tailwind utility classes for styling. No CSS modules or styled-components.
Keep code clean, typed, and accessible (semantic HTML + ARIA where needed).
